bobDecision.summary: Direct upgrade to Node 20 is recommended for this TypeScript monorepo
bobDecision.rationale: The repository has no dependency blockers, uses modern TypeScript with pnpm workspaces, and all identified issues are in test fixtures rather than production code. The main codebase is already well-structured for Node 20 compatibility.
prioritizedRisks: Test fixtures contain outdated Docker configurations (Node 16, 18)
Test fixtures use deprecated Node APIs (Buffer constructor, process.binding, module.parent)
Test fixtures mix ESM and CommonJS patterns
chosenSolutions: Update test fixture Dockerfiles to Node 20 base images
Refactor test fixture code to use modern Buffer APIs
Standardize module system in test fixtures
Add Node 20 to CI/CD pipeline if not already present
tradeoffs: Test fixtures need updates but don't block production upgrade
No staged upgrade needed since dependencies are compatible
TypeScript compilation target may need review for optimal Node 20 features
